facts.fact: The Marketech APAC 2024 gala awards night, where StackAdapt was recognised, was held in Singapore on November 28.
facts.quote: The gala awards night, held in Singapore on November 28, awarded StackAdapt silver in the category of Best AdTech Platform in APAC.

facts.fact: StackAdapt won silver in the Best AdTech Platform in APAC category at the Marketech APAC 2024 Marketing Technology Awards.
facts.quote: awarded StackAdapt silver in the category of Best AdTech Platform in APAC

facts.fact: According to StackAdapt, it had built a team of more than sixty people across APAC.
facts.quote: We have built a substantial team of more than sixty people across APAC

facts.fact: According to StackAdapt's self-description, its platform is used by hundreds of brands and agencies around the world.
facts.quote: used by hundreds of brands and agencies around the world

facts.fact: StackAdapt states it is rated the number 1 demand-side platform (DSP) on G2, a third-party review site.
The StackAdapt Marketech APAC 2024 award announcement was published on November 29, 2024.
